crossRefs.note: Yahweh hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken to Moses.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.
Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also, and he didn’t let the people go.
God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;
But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened so that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly…
So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not so much as one of the livestock of the Israelites dead. But the heart of Pharaoh was stubborn, and he didn’t let the people go.
translations.bsb: Pharaoh sent officials and found that none of the livestock of the Israelites had died. But Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not let the people go.
translations.kjv: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.
translations.asv: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not so much as one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. But the heart of Pharaoh was stubborn, and he did not let the people go.
